item.title: A Hilarious Trip Through Some of the Foundation's Most Infamous SCP's
item.content:encoded:
And their hair-brained attempts to kill what just won't stay dead.

I think at this point, the Foundation's attempt to torture and mutilate 682 has caused far more harm than good, and if there was even a cell of good in him (he seemed to like that one little girl)… Well, all that's left is a whole lot of hate.

And yet the more hair-brained the attempt, the more fun the read.

I'm hoping that there will continue to be even more hair-brained entries, and when ideas using SCPs runs out-and this is my over-imagination talking, I'd love to see him thrown in with characters from other universes.

We all know what would happen if 682 and someone like Vegeto were to be thrown into a fight together (682 would eventually adapt and become even more powerful, with the ability to launch blasts capable of destroying the planet), but I'd just love to read a showdown where his opponent apparently has him outmatched, and just keeps pushing his buttons, along the lines of Vegeto vs. Super Buu. I think 682 would throw death threats left and right, and curse like a drunk sailor! Probably in multiple languages.

In the meantime, I have plenty more termination entries to read, and this gem here!

item.title: Ideas
item.content:encoded:
If anyone can post here, I have two ideas:

Item: High speed precision blades, several forms of anti-aircraft weaponry, railgun based weaponry, bombardment with napalm, detonation of several medium level explosives, (maybe a few more things, not sure)

Tissue Test Record: N/A

Termination Test Record: SCP-682 was moved into a large containment unit to allow for the use of the anti-air and rail-gun weaponry. Weapons are engaged, and commence firing at 682 for a period of thirty (30) minutes. After period ended, weaponry was disengaged, and two D-class personnel are sent in to check for SCP-682 remains.

D-class personnel report no remains, and are escorted out of the containment cell. Approximately 24 hours later, a mass containment breach occurs, caused in part by 682. Investigation later revealed that a fragment of 682's cranial matter with less than 1 centimetre of surface area has latched onto one of the D-class personnel, and was able to regenerate from that fragment

Note: We severely underestimated SCP-682's regenerative abilities. It seems as though it can regenerate from any amount of matter left over. - Dr. (Something something)

Item: A microwave, contructed by the Foundation and large enough to fit a human.
Tissue Test Record: Tissue sample began to bubble, and after 30 seconds, exploded.
Termination Test Record: Denied by O5 command

Note: While this could be a way to get incapacitating of SCP-682, there is no data to actually show that it will destroy the subject. Furthermore, if SCP-682 becomes resistant to microwave radiation, or learns how to emit it itself, this could prove disastrous to not only the Foundation, but the rest of the planet as well.

Also, SCP-297

item.title: Moderator Post - Pruning
item.content:encoded:
The following entry was pruned, since it successfully terminated 682 and therefore defeats the purpose of this test log.

+ Log
- Close

Item: Memetic Kill Agent

Tissue Test Record: N/A

Termination Test Record: A monitor is hoisted down containing a memetic kill agent similar to the one contained in [REDACTED]'s file. SCP-682 is then instructed view the monitor, but refuses to comply with the Site-██ █████████ Command. D-████ then proceeds to enter the containment chamber and had numerously attempted to assault SCP-682 at SCP-682 nearest to the monitor, with the objective to bait SCP-682 to look at the screen providing the Memetic Kill Agent. The following Addendum displays the chambers microphone output to the Site-██ Control Station.

Addendum Log ██-█

SCP-682: What are you doing?
███████: …
SCP-682: I'll fucking kill you if you don't tell me. I'LL CLAW YOUR FUCKING EYES OUT ASWELL YOU HOEBAG.
D-████: Hey man! Shut the fuck up! I've already killed ██ people, including my █████████████!
███████: SCP Six Eight Two. Look at the monitor IMMEDIATELY or we will place you into Isolation Chamber-█.
SCP-682: I don't listen to you hoe-bags at the Foundation, I'M MORE SUPERIOR AND DOMINANT AND CAN KILL YOU ALL NOW. *SCP-682 proceeds to attempt and escape, causing ██ casualties*
D-████: I see why you're trying to kill this motherfucker! *D-████ attempts to assault SCP-682 multiple times before stopping in pain*
D-████: What's the name of this thing?
SCP-682: ██████████████████ *Looks at monitor*
*Audio cuts off, emergency control-room shutter closed.*

Upon SCP-682 being instructed to view the monitor, it lets a roar out that travels many wavelengths and attempts to escape once again, causing ██ casualties, though, whenever the attempt is interrupted by D-████'s voice, SCP-682 swiftly looks at D-████, catching the majority of the Memetic Kill Agent for ██ seconds. Due to do SCP-682 viewing the Memetic Kill Agent. SCP-682 immediately had both heart and organ failures instantly. SCP-682s Containment Chamber is then, evacuated and filled with gas from the Nuerotoxin fail-safe.

Due to the fail safe being activated, Doctor ███████, stationed in SCP-682s Containment Chamber for vital monitoring was ████████ by the ██████ gas. The control room once loud, turned silent; a voice on the radio had broke the silence, it was from no other than O5-█, the ████████████. The voice shouted "Well done, ██████. Six Eight Two has been terminated. Mobile Task Force █████-1 is ETA in 32 minutes, so prepare evacuation of the proximity of the chamber." Following the arrival of MTF █████-1, Area-██ is evacuated to the nearest breach/evacuation/nuclear shelter, whereas the Mobile Task Forces will soon arrive at upon order.

Addendum Log █████-████-███
Upon the arrival of MTF █████-1, the Task Force immediately did a thorough sweep of the Entrance Sector, and Light Containment Zone. Upon entering the █████ ███████████ Zone, MTF █████-1 immediately dropped the objective of sweeping, and had entered SCP-682s Containment Chamber. Prior to them arriving, the gas fail-safe in SCP-682s chamber was disabled, which had been confirmed through the Input and Output logs at Site-██. MTF █████-1 had entered the chamber, and found the body of D-█████ and Doctor ███████. The Mobile Task Force had then, confirmed the termination of SCP-682. Following those hours, MTF █████-1 was ordered to terminate all staff at Area-██. MTF █████-1 gathered all Foundation Personnel at Area-██, and were instructed to fire at them at will. All survivors were hunted with the cameras, and so it remains, what happened to Area-██?

█ months following the termination of SCP-682, it's corpse was transferred to the Site-███ Research Compound where it had begun research for █ years after incineration at the now, inactive and abandoned Area-██.

Every now and then, there's a voice I hear.

"SCP-682… Neutralized? I'll be back in ████ years, you wait, just you wait."

Meta Note: Guys i get that you want some suspenseful ending but to do that can we use something that wasn't already a failure previously? If any of you read through this you'll see that the Foundation already tried to kill him with MULTIPLE memetic kill agents AT ONCE previously, in this exact test log, so why in the █████ would just a singular one work now? Just because they wanted it to really hard? I get if you think this document should have a big mystery element at the end, but come on. Change it to something that hasn't already been tried before at least, for gods sake

I'd like to quickly add on to the above.
To the writer of the Neutralisation Log: I recommend that you read/re-read the newbie guide, practice and perfect your writing skills, and ultimately keep SCP-682 alive. I think Hope the SCP community can agree with me when I say that SCP-682's termination log was never intended to result in 682's demise, but rather house the fun and desperate ways the foundation attempted to do so.

But in the end, I'm pretty sure an Admin will erase this all from existence.

Kind Regards,
Dr Ivan Leonhart

item.title: Re: Omission in SCP-1237?
item.content:encoded:
To ascertain the author of a given test:

read the article history, find out at what point the test was added to the log, see who is credited with that edit.

Bear in mind that the person who did it, may have stopped participating in the SCP Foundation project.

item.title: Re: Omission in SCP-1237?
item.content:encoded:
Thank you! How does one find out the author of test anyway? I also see what I think may be an omission in the SCP-294 test, and I think I know how to fix it.

Namely, the omission seems to be that they did not assign a team (probably with D-class) to collect the necessary amount from SCP-294 ASAP.

Te fix would be that they did, but the liquid has proved unstable. By the time you collect the necessary amount, most of it has gone useless. "Stable SCP-682 killer" returns OUT OF RANGE. Bonus suggestion: D-class consuming the liquid does not suffer major ill effects.
